text:
sarah: customer (org-8274) flagged an invoice gap — their SDK estimator shows 1,120 tokens but invoice billed ~1,472 (+352). They claim one system message + one user prompt + one completion. Pls advise, assigning to support.
kevin: can you paste the exact curl they used and whether it was streaming or non-streaming?
sarah: here's the repro they sent:
```bash
curl -s -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "open-llama-13b",
    "stream": true,
    "messages": [
      {"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},
      {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following..."}
    ]
  }'
```
They say they stream, then immediately reconnect to fetch missed final chunk.
metering-bot: automated-detect: request_id=rr-219874, server_injected_kv=true, tool_call_replay=0, observed_resume_events=1
mike: oof. streaming + immediate reconnect is a known footgun. If reconnect overlaps cached prefix, metering may count the final tokens twice (final chunk replay + cached replay). Did they close socket mid-final?
sarah: customer said their client closed on finish_reason: stop then re-opened within 200ms to poll. sdk-js v0.9.
ada: check for logs with "stream-resume" and "final-chunk-idx" around rr-219874. Gateway emits replay frames when resume happens. If client reconnected before ACK of final chunk, the runtime can replay and both the initial send and the replay get tallied.
kevin: also verify whether any server-inserted tool/system messages were appended after the client's last ack (we've seen hidden kv_metadata and tool flags inflate counts). ask for invoice line item timestamps.
sarah: customer attached invoice snippet and their local tokenizer count. They use local tokenizer v1 which counts differently for trailing newline tokens.
mike: two potential sources: 1) duplicate final chunk on reconnect, 2) server-injected KV/tool metadata appended post-response. Both can add ~100s of tokens depending on model. short repro: force a streaming disconnect right after newline and reconnect, compare metering logs.
ada: mitigation: ask customer to use non-streaming or add exponential backoff before reconnect. long-term: we should de-duplicate replayed tokens at the gateway when idempotency header provided.
kevin: i'll pull metering lines for rr-219874 and correlate to invoice timestamps. if we find double-count, we can credit the account and file bug with eng-runtime.
sarah: created SUP-4821 and assigned to eng-runtime. attached curl + invoice lines in the ticket. customer good with provisional credit if we confirm duplication.
mike: I'll own the runtime issue. quick triage: search for resume events in last 48h, filter by model and account, and list candidates for automated crediting.
ada: I'll propose a gateway patch: honor X-Idempotency-Key for stream resumes to avoid replay charge duplication. Also add a metering-audit flag customers can turn on to get detailed token diffs.
sarah: thanks all. I told customer the temporary workaround (disable immediate reconnect / use non-streaming) and that we'll update them when SUP-4821 has a root cause. :thumbsup:
kevin: noted. please paste any metering lines here when you have them so support can update the invoice record. :eyes:
